package parameterstyles_test

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/parameterstyles/gen/http/styles/client"
	svc "example.com/parameterstyles/gen/styles"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestGeneratedForeignParameters(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, path, cookie string
		payload            any
		rejected           bool
	}{
		{"path-label-dot-lowercase-hex", "/PathLabel/%2E%2e", "", &svc.PathLabelPayload{Value: "."}, false},
		{"path-label-empty-lowercase-hex", "/PathLabel/%2e", "", &svc.PathLabelPayload{Value: ""}, false},
		{"path-pct2e-proxy", "/PathLabel/%2E%2E", "", &svc.PathLabelPayload{Value: "."}, false},
		{"query-deepobject-literal-brackets", "/QueryObject?value[R]=100&value[G]=200", "", &svc.QueryObjectPayload{Value: &svc.ParameterRange{R: "100", G: "200"}}, false},
		{"query-residual-foreign-key", "/QueryResidual?control=kept&utm_source=foreign", "", &svc.QueryResidualPayload{Control: "kept", Value: map[string]string{"utm_source": "foreign"}}, false},
		{"query-delimited-repeated-key-400", "/QueryList?value=secret&value=other", "", nil, true},
		{"query-object-odd-count-400", "/QueryObjectPlain?value=R,secret,G", "", nil, true},
		{"query-object-duplicate-400", "/QueryObjectPlain?value=R,secret,R,other", "", nil, true},
		{"query-object-unknown-property-400", "/QueryObjectPlain?value=R,100,G,200,unknown,secret", "", nil, true},
		{"cookie-optional-default", "/CookieDefault", "", &svc.CookieDefaultPayload{Value:"blue"}, false},
{"query-list-optional-default", "/QueryListDefault", "", &svc.QueryListDefaultPayload{Value:[]string{"blue"}}, false},
{"query-object-property-default", "/QueryObjectDefault?value[R]=given", "", &svc.QueryObjectDefaultPayload{Value:&svc.ParameterDefaults{R:"given",G:7}}, false},
{"cookie-legacy-quoted-peer", "/CookieScalar", `value="hello world"`, &svc.CookieScalarPayload{Value: "hello world"}, false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			host, observed := newStylesServer(t)
			req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(), http.MethodGet, host.URL+tc.path, nil)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if tc.name == "path-pct2e-proxy" {
				req.URL.RawPath = strings.ReplaceAll(req.URL.RawPath, "%2E", ".")
			}
			req.Header.Set("Cookie", tc.cookie)
			response, err := host.Client().Do(req)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			bytes, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			if tc.rejected {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, response.StatusCode, string(bytes))
				var problem loomhttp.ProblemResponse
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(bytes, &problem))
				require.Equal(t, loom.DecodePayload, problem.Code)
				require.Contains(t, problem.Detail, "value")
				require.NotContains(t, problem.Detail, "secret")
				require.Zero(t, observed.calls.Load())
				return
			}
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, response.StatusCode, string(bytes))
			require.Equal(t, int32(1), observed.calls.Load())
			require.Equal(t, tc.payload, observed.payload)
		})
	}
}

func TestGeneratedParameterPresenceAndForm(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("query-rule-a-optional-empty", func(t *testing.T) {
		host, observed := newStylesServer(t)
		address, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		doer := &recordingDoer{t: t, base: host.Client()}
		c := client.NewClient(address.Scheme, address.Host, doer, loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
		_, err = c.QueryOptional()(t.Context(), &svc.QueryOptionalPayload{Value: []string{}})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Empty(t, doer.query)
		require.Equal(t, int32(1), observed.calls.Load())
		require.Equal(t, &svc.QueryOptionalPayload{}, observed.payload)
	})
	t.Run("query-rule-a-missing-400", func(t *testing.T) {
		host, observed := newStylesServer(t)
		response, err := host.Client().Get(host.URL + "/QueryRequired")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer func() {
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
		}()
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, response.StatusCode)
		require.Zero(t, observed.calls.Load())
		var problem loomhttp.ProblemResponse
		require.NoError(t, json.UnmarshalRead(response.Body, &problem))
		require.Contains(t, problem.Detail, "value")
		require.NotEmpty(t, problem.Code)
	})
	t.Run("form-field-codecs-and-getbody", func(t *testing.T) {
		host, observed := newStylesServer(t)
		address, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		doer := &recordingDoer{t: t, base: host.Client()}
		c := client.NewClient(address.Scheme, address.Host, doer, loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
		payload := &svc.FormFieldsPayload{
			Filter: &svc.ParameterRange{R: "100", G: "200"},
			Tags:   []string{"a,b", "c"}, Attributes: map[string]string{"x": "y"},
			Flags: map[string]string{"enabled": "yes"}, Owner: "Ann",
			Facets: &svc.ParameterRange{R:"100",G:"200"}, Jsonattrs: map[string]string{"foo":"bar"},
			Search:[]string{"one,two","three"},
		}
		_, err = c.FormFields()(t.Context(), payload)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, doer.status)
		require.Equal(t, int32(1), observed.calls.Load())
		require.Equal(t, payload, observed.payload)
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "filter%5BR%5D=100")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "filter%5BG%5D=200")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "tags=a%2Cb,c")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "attributes=x,y")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "enabled=yes")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "owner=Ann")
		require.Equal(t, "search=one%2Ctwo,three", doer.query)
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "R=100")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "G=200")
		require.Contains(t, doer.body, "jsonattrs=%7B%22foo%22%3A%22bar%22%7D")
	})
	for _, invalid := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "response-header-map"
		if invalid {
			name = "response-header-unrepresentable-before-commit"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			host, observed := newStylesServer(t)
			if invalid {
				observed.response = map[string]string{"env": "secret,other"}
			}
			response, err := host.Client().Get(host.URL + "/ResponseMap")
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			require.Equal(t, int32(1), observed.calls.Load())
			if invalid {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusInternalServerError, response.StatusCode)
				require.Empty(t, response.Header.Get("X-Labels"))
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, response.StatusCode)
				require.Equal(t, "env=prod, tier=1", response.Header.Get("X-Labels"))
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGeneratedStrictCookiePeer(t *testing.T) {
 var calls int
 host := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
  calls++
  // This peer implements the unquoted cookie contract independently of
  // net/http's permissive Cookie parser.
  raw := r.Header.Get("Cookie")
  require.NotContains(t, raw, `"`)
  pair := strings.SplitN(raw, "=", 2)
  require.Equal(t, []string{"value", "hello world"}, pair)
  w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
 }))
 defer host.Close()
 address, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 c := client.NewClient(address.Scheme, address.Host, host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
 _, err = c.CookieScalar()(t.Context(), &svc.CookieScalarPayload{Value:"hello world"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
}
